column3: With respect to the Raymond Center Mortgage Loan (2.2%), (a) the lease for Five Below, Inc., the second largest tenant at the Mortgaged Property (approximately 13.0% of the net rentable area), has a co-tenancy provision tied to HomeGoods, the largest tenant at the Mortgaged Property (or a comparable replacement) (approximately 26.9% of the net rentable area), and Ulta Salon, Cosmetics & Fragrances, Inc. (“Ulta”), the third largest tenant at the Mortgaged Property (approximately 11.8% of the net rentable area); and (b) the lease for Ulta has a co-tenancy provision tied to HomeGoods. See “Risk Factors—Risks Relating to the Mortgage Loans—Underwritten Net Cash Flow Could Be Based On Incorrect or Flawed Assumptions”.
